task: The REVIEW->TEST docs-drift preflight gate passes deps.projectRoot (metadataRoot) as repoRoot to runDocsDriftGate, so on wrapper-root layouts (metadataRoot != gitRoot) its fs.existsSync + git grep run from a non-git directory and falsely report existing CLAUDE.md path references as missing, false-blocking REVIEW->TEST.
outcome: On a wrapper-root project the REVIEW->TEST preflight prints the docs-drift gate as: `[docs-drift] pass` (no false missing-path drift) and REVIEW->TEST proceeds; on a plain repo (projectRoot==gitCwd) output is byte-identical to before. A new wrapper-root regression runs green under `lattice validate` / root `npm test`, and is provably red if review-preflight reverts to passing metadataRoot as repoRoot.
facts: review-preflight.ts ~:287 resolves gitCwd once via resolveGitCwd({store,storyId,metadataRoot:deps.projectRoot,projectRoot:deps.projectRoot}); channel(~:298), concept(~:313), english(~:464) gates already receive gitCwd.
review-preflight.ts ~:423-426 calls runDocsDriftGate(mdContents, deps.registryNames, {repoRoot: deps.projectRoot, managedAssetDefs}) — repoRoot wrongly bound to metadataRoot.

runDocsDriftGate (validate-docs-drift.ts:441) only runs path-drift when opts.repoRoot is set, delegating to checkPathDrift -> scanPathDrift (core/audit-scan.ts:214) which does pathExists(join(repoRoot,p)) and defaultGrepLiteral with execSync git grep {cwd: repoRoot}.
Both fs-exists and git grep are scoped by repoRoot; on metadataRoot!=gitRoot a real existing path is reported missing -> docs-drift FAIL.
Existing smokes docs-drift-path-drift-smoke.ts and gitroot-cwd-contract-smoke.ts never build a metadataRoot!=gitRoot layout, so this class is untested.

gitroot-cwd-contract-smoke.ts uses BARE_CWD_REGEX /\bcwd:\s*(projectRoot|root|metadataRoot)\s*[,}]/ that only flags bare-identifier git cwd; it cannot catch metadataRoot forwarded under a param name like repoRoot.

Smokes auto-discover via run-all-smokes.ts discoverSmokes (*-smoke.js) and selectSmokes(smoke-manifest.json); root npm test runs an explicit subset; a new smoke must be wired into the battery the user runs (root npm test / lattice validate).
This is the exact B-0740 defect class (resolved gitCwd not threaded into one git-invoking gate).
